lines: Caveman browse uses 121 tokens instead of 15704 for a Playwright snapshot
Agents read too much text and waste tokens on chatter.
Caveman teaches your agent to speak plainly so you save tokens on big tasks.
It compresses logs and code files to less than 2% of their original size while keeping every number correct.
Try compressing a CSV file from 28,041 tokens down to exactly 314.
Logs become 98.5% smaller with whole sessions using 33.2% fewer input tokens.
JetBrains tasks lost output tokens by 8.5% while keeping quality unchanged.
It shrinks memory files like CLAUDE.md by 46% while keeping all headings and code blocks intact.
Julius Brussee made Caveman with Apache-2.0 license, tested by Adobe Research.
Type this in your terminal: npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g.
Save this for a friend who wastes tokens on chatter.
Caveman cuts tokens while keeping every fact exact.
